The theme may be stated in Luther's well-known words, "A mighty fortress is our God." entries.content_plain: PSALM 46 Psa 46:1-11 . Upon Alamoth--most probably denotes the treble, or part sung by female voices, the word meaning "virgins"; and which was sung with some appropriately keyed instrument (compare 1Ch 15:19-21 ; see on Psa 6:1 , title). The theme may be stated in Luther's well-known words, "A mighty fortress is our God." The great deliverance ( 2Ki 19:35 ; Is 37:36 ) may have occasioned its composition. 1. refuge-- literally, "a place of trust" ( Psa 2:12 ). strength-- ( Psa 18:2 ). present help-- literally, "a help He has been found exceedingly." trouble-- as in Psa 18:7 .
